reasoning: This is a GitOps configuration repository that provides Kustomize layers and Helm charts for deploying and managing OpenDataHub/RHOAI dependencies on OpenShift clusters. It contains no application source code, no operator controllers, no libraries, and no services. Instead it provides: (1) reusable Kustomize components for operator subscriptions (cert-manager, kueue, NVIDIA GPU operator, etc.), (2) Kustomize overlays composing those components into deployable dependency sets, (3) post-install operator configurations (CRs for Kueue, RHCL, etc.), and (4) Helm charts for OCP and non-OCP Kubernetes deployments. The repository is designed to be consumed by GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) or applied directly via kubectl, serving as a single source of truth for the platform's prerequisite infrastructure.
